title: Study Skills & First Jobs
description: Prepare for academic study and entering the job market in English: writing CVs and cover letters, performing in job interviews, taking effective notes, and managing academic tasks. Designed for B1 learners who are studying or beginning their professional careers.

content.content: {"time":1700070002000,"blocks":[{"id":"ntA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Good notes help you study more effectively. The key is to record the main ideas, not every word."}},{"id":"ntD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Note-Taking Tips","level":3}},{"id":"ntG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"ordered","items":["Use abbreviations: e.g., w/ (with), b/c (because), → (leads to), + (and/plus)","Write key words only, not full sentences","Use bullet points and numbered lists for clarity","Highlight definitions and examples","Review your notes within 24 hours to improve retention"]}},{"id":"ntJ0kK1lL2m","type":"header","data":{"text":"Useful Lecture Phrases to Listen For","level":3}},{"id":"ntM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["'The main point is...' — write this down!","'In other words...' — a simpler explanation follows","'This is important...' — likely to be in the exam","'To summarise...' — the end of a section"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

questions.text: What is the best note-taking strategy?
options: Record key words and main ideas only

questions.text: A lecturer says 'The main point is...' What should you do?

content.content: {"time":1700070003000,"blocks":[{"id":"cvA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"A CV (curriculum vitae) is a document that summarises your education, experience, and skills. In the UK, a standard CV is 1–2 pages."}},{"id":"cvD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Sections of a CV","level":3}},{"id":"cvG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"ordered","items":["Personal details — name, email, phone, location (no photo needed in UK)","Personal statement / profile — 2–3 sentences about you and your goals","Work experience — most recent job first","Education — most recent qualification first","Skills — languages, IT skills, etc.","References — 'Available on request' is acceptable"]}},{"id":"cvJ0kK1lL2m","type":"header","data":{"text":"Power Verbs for a CV","level":3}},{"id":"cvM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["managed, led, developed, achieved, improved, coordinated, delivered, supported"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

Practising your answers to common questions will help you perform much better."}},{"id":"jiD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Common Questions","level":3}},{"id":"jiG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Tell me about yourself. — Give a 2-minute professional summary.","Why do you want this job? — Show you've researched the company.","What are your strengths and weaknesses? — Be honest and balanced.","Where do you see yourself in five years? — Show ambition but be realistic.","Do you have any questions for us? — Always prepare 2–3 questions!"]}},{"id":"jiJ0kK1lL2m","type":"header","data":{"text":"The STAR Method (for Behavioural Questions)","level":3}},{"id":"jiM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"ordered","items":["Situation — Describe the context","Task — Explain your responsibility","Action — Say what you did","Result — Describe the outcome"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: Tell me about yourself. Well, I recently graduated in Business Management and I have six months of internship experience in marketing. I'm very organised and I enjoy working in a team.
